tabs.title: Tab

tabs.content:
energy_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1h)
| summarize Zeilen = count() by Eingang = bin(ingestion_time(), 5m)
| order by Eingang desc



energy_latest
| summarize Werte = count() by endpoint, series_id, series_name, unit
| order by endpoint asc, series_id asc

energy_latest
| where endpoint == "cbpf" and series_id != "sum" and ts > ago(8h)
| summarize Laender_mit_Wert = countif(value != 0), Summe_GW = round(sum(value), 2) by ts
| order by ts desc

energy_raw
| where endpoint == "public_power" and ts > ago(1d)
| summarize value = take_any(value) by series_id, ts, generated_at
| order by series_id asc, ts asc, generated_at asc
| extend geaendert = series_id == prev(series_id) and ts == prev(ts) and value != prev(value)
| where geaendert
| extend Alter_h = (generated_at - ts) / 1h
| summarize Korrekturen = count(),
            Max_Alter_h = round(max(Alter_h), 1),
            P95_Alter_h = round(percentile(Alter_h, 95), 1)

energy_latest
| where endpoint == "public_power" and ts == datetime(2026-10-08 10:00)
| project series_name, MW = round(value, 0)
| order by MW desc

energy_raw
| where endpoint == "public_power" and ts > ago(1d)
| summarize value = take_any(value) by series_id, ts, generated_at
| order by series_id asc, ts asc, generated_at asc
| extend geaendert = series_id == prev(series_id) and ts == prev(ts) and value != prev(value)
| where geaendert
| extend Alter_h = (generated_at - ts) / 1h
| summarize Korrekturen = count() by Alter = bin(Alter_h, 0.5)
| order by Alter asc

energy_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(30m) and ts < ago(6h)
| summarize Zeilen = count(), Aeltester = min(ts), Juengster = max(ts) by endpoint


let nachher = energy_raw
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(30m) and endpoint == "public_power" and ts < ago(6h)
    | summarize arg_max(generated_at, value) by series_id, ts;
let vorher = energy_raw
    | where ingestion_time() <= ago(30m) and endpoint == "public_power"
    | summarize arg_max(generated_at, value) by series_id, ts;
nachher
| join kind=inner vorher on series_id, ts
| extend Diff = value - value1
| summarize Werte_verglichen = count(),
            Davon_korrigiert = countif(abs(Diff) > 0.01),
            Max_Abweichung_MW = round(max(abs(Diff)), 1)



energy_latest
| where endpoint == "public_power" and ts == datetime(2026-10-08 10:00)
| project series_name, MW = round(value, 0)
| order by MW desc

energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price"
| summarize Werte = count(), Von = min(ts), Bis = max(ts) by series_id, series_name, unit

energy_latest
| where endpoint == "cbpf" and series_id == "sweden" and ts > ago(2d)
| project Zeit = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"), GW = value
| order by Zeit desc


energy_raw
| where endpoint == "cbpf" and series_id == "sweden" and ts > ago(12h)
| summarize Werte = make_set(value), Erster_Abruf = min(generated_at), Letzter_Abruf = max(generated_at) by ts
| project Zeit = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"), Werte, Erster_Abruf, Letzter_Abruf
| order by Zeit desc



let Laender = datatable(series_id: string, Land: string)
[
    "austria", "Österreich", "belgium", "Belgien", "czech_republic", "Tschechien",
    "denmark", "Dänemark", "france", "Frankreich", "luxembourg", "Luxemburg",
    "netherlands", "Niederlande", "norway", "Norwegen", "poland", "Polen",
    "sweden", "Schweden", "switzerland", "Schweiz"
];
let cbpf_ts = energy_latest
    | where endpoint == "cbpf" and series_id != "sum"
    | summarize Gemeldet = countif(value != 0) by ts;
let cbpf_max = toscalar(energy_latest | where endpoint == "cbpf" | summarize max(ts));
let voll11 = toscalar(cbpf_ts | where ts <= cbpf_max - 30m and Gemeldet >= 11 | summarize max(ts));
let voll10 = toscalar(cbpf_ts | where ts <= cbpf_max - 30m and Gemeldet >= 10 | summarize max(ts));
let LetzterVollstaendig = iff(isnotnull(voll11) and voll11 >= cbpf_max - 6h, voll11, voll10);
energy_latest
| where endpoint == "cbpf" and ts == LetzterVollstaendig
| join kind=inner Laender on series_id
| project Land, GW = round(value, 2)
| order by GW desc

energy_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(30m)
| summarize Zeilen = count(),
            ts_leer = countif(isnull(ts)),
            value_leer = countif(isnull(value)),
            Frequenz_falsch_hier = countif(endpoint == "frequency")
    by Eingang = bin(ingestion_time(), 5m)
| order by Eingang desc



frequency_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(30m)
| summarize Zeilen = count(), ts_leer = countif(isnull(ts)), hz_leer = countif(isnull(hz))


Netzfrequenz()
| summarize Werte = count(), Von = min(ts), Bis = max(ts),
            Verzoegerung_s = datetime_diff("second", now(), max(ts)),
            Min_Hz = min(hz), Max_Hz = max(hz)

frequency_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(30m)
| summarize Zeilen = count(), ts_leer = countif(isnull(ts)), hz_leer = countif(isnull(hz))


Netzfrequenz()
| summarize Werte = count(), Von = min(ts), Bis = max(ts),
            Verzoegerung_s = datetime_diff("second", now(), max(ts)),
            Min_Hz = min(hz), Max_Hz = max(hz)

energy_latest
| where endpoint == "price"
| extend Zeit = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| where Zeit between (datetime_utc_to_local(now() - 3h, "Europe/Berlin") .. datetime_utc_to_local(now() + 3h, "Europe/Berlin"))
| project Zeit, EUR_MWh = value, ct_kWh = value / 10
| order by Zeit asc

Netzfrequenz()
| where ts > ago(1d)
| order by ts asc
| extend vorher = prev(ts)
| extend Luecke_s = datetime_diff("second", ts, vorher)
| where Luecke_s > 5
| project Luecke_von = datetime_utc_to_local(vorher, "Europe/Berlin"),
          Luecke_bis = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"),
          Luecke_s



frequency_raw
| where ingestion_time() > ago(30m)
| summarize Zeilen = count(),
            Aeltester = datetime_utc_to_local(min(ts), "Europe/Berlin"),
            Juengster = datetime_utc_to_local(max(ts), "Europe/Berlin")


frequency_raw
| where ts between (datetime(2026-10-09 23:59:40) .. datetime(2026-10-10 00:00:10))
| summarize Anzahl_Lieferungen = count(), hz = take_any(hz) by ts
| extend Ortszeit = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin")
| order by ts asc

Netzfrequenz()
| where ts between (datetime(2026-10-10 23:50:00) .. datetime(2026-10-11 00:00:30))
| order by ts asc
| extend Letzter_Wert_davor = prev(ts)
| extend Luecke_s = datetime_diff("second", ts, Letzter_Wert_davor)
| where Luecke_s > 1
| project Letzter_Wert_davor, Naechster_Wert = ts, Fehlende_Sekunden = Luecke_s - 1


Netzfrequenz()
| where ts > ago(7d)
| order by ts asc
| extend Letzter_Wert_davor = prev(ts)
| extend Fehlende_Sekunden = datetime_diff("second", ts, Letzter_Wert_davor) - 1
| where Fehlende_Sekunden > 0
| project Von_lokal = datetime_utc_to_local(Letzter_Wert_davor, "Europe/Berlin"),
          Bis_lokal = datetime_utc_to_local(ts, "Europe/Berlin"),
          Fehlende_Sekunden
| order by Von_lokal desc

.create-or-alter function with (folder = "Power", docstring = "Grid frequency in second resolution (deduplicated)")
GridFrequency() {
    frequency_1s
    | project ts, hz, deviation_mhz = round((hz - 50) * 1000, 1)
}


GridFrequency()
| summarize Values = count(), From = min(ts), To = max(ts)


.create materialized-view with (backfill=true) frequency_1min on table frequency_raw
{
    frequency_raw
    | summarize hz_min = min(hz), hz_avg = avg(hz), hz_max = max(hz), samples = count()
        by ts = bin(ts, 1m)
}


.alter-merge materialized-view frequency_1min policy retention softdelete = 36500d recoverability = enabled



.alter materialized-view frequency_1min policy caching hot = 365d


frequency_1min
| summarize Minutes = count(), From = min(ts), To = max(ts), Avg_samples = avg(samples)



.drop function Netzfrequenz


.show functions


  GridFrequency()
  | summarize Values = count(), To = max(ts), Delay_s = datetime_diff("second", now(), max(ts))
